# 红人报价与商务谈判模板

以下模板用于首次报价沟通、预算协商、合作范围调整以及礼貌拒绝。

谈判时应保持尊重，避免贬低创作者的内容价值，也不要承诺尚未获批的长期合作。

## 一、首次合作预算不足

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your rates and for your interest in collaborating with us.

We really appreciate the quality of your content, especially [Specific detail], which is why we wanted to explore the possibility of working together.

At the moment, our budget for an initial test collaboration is more limited than your usual rate. Would you be open to considering [Budget] for one video on [Platform]?

We would also provide the product, and if the collaboration performs well, we would be happy to evaluate additional opportunities in the future.

I completely understand if this is below your usual rate, but I wanted to ask because we genuinely think your content could be a great fit.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 二、从 300 美元协商到 150 美元

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your rate and media kit. We really enjoyed reviewing your content and can see why your work would be a good fit for our product.

For this initial collaboration, our current testing budget is closer to $150 for one short-form video, in addition to the complimentary product.

Would there be any flexibility to make this work for a first project?

We completely understand the value of your work and would be happy to explore additional collaborations if this first campaign is a good fit for both sides.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 三、报价较高但仍希望争取

Hi [Name],

Thank you for getting back to me and for sharing your rates.

To be completely transparent, your standard rate is currently above the budget available for this campaign. However, we were particularly interested in working with you because [Specific reason].

Would you be open to a simplified collaboration at [Budget], focused on one organic video on [Platform]?

We would not require paid advertising rights, exclusivity, or additional deliverables, which we hope might make the collaboration more workable.

I completely understand if this is not possible, but I wanted to check before closing the opportunity.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 四、取消不需要的广告授权

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing the package details.

The proposed package looks great. However, for this campaign, we are mainly interested in the organic video post and do not currently need paid advertising usage rights, whitelisting, or exclusivity.

Would it be possible to adjust the package and offer a revised rate for the video post only?

Our current target budget is [Budget], and we would love to see whether there is a way to make the collaboration work.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 五、争取跨平台同步

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your rate.

We’re very interested in moving forward and wanted to ask whether you would be open to posting the video on [Primary platform] and sharing the same video on [Secondary platform] as part of the collaboration.

Our available budget for this first project is [Budget], and we would not require paid usage rights or exclusivity.

Please let me know whether this might be workable for you.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 六、产品与佣金组合

Hi [Name],

Thank you for your reply.

Our current cash budget for this initial collaboration is [Budget], and we would also provide the product at no cost.

Depending on the campaign setup, we may also be able to support the collaboration with an affiliate opportunity or a dedicated audience discount, which could help create additional value beyond the fixed fee.

Would you be open to discussing a structure like this?

Best,  
[Your name]

只有佣金活动或折扣确实可以提供时，才可以使用该模板。

## 七、两款产品打包合作

Hi [Name],

We would love to explore a slightly broader collaboration featuring two products: one smart lock and one home security camera.

Would you be open to creating one video for each product and offering a package rate for both?

Our goal would be to keep the content natural and focused on how each product fits into everyday home life.

If this sounds interesting, could you please share your best rate for the two-video package?

Best,  
[Your name]

## 八、最终预算说明

Hi [Name],

Thank you again for your flexibility and for taking the time to discuss this collaboration.

I checked internally once more, and the highest budget we can currently approve for this first project is [Maximum budget].

This would include [Deliverables], with the product provided by us.

We completely understand if this does not align with your current rates, but I wanted to be transparent and see whether there is any possibility of moving forward within that budget.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 九、礼貌拒绝高报价

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your rates and for considering the collaboration.

We really appreciate your interest, but unfortunately, your current rate is outside the budget available for this campaign.

We completely understand and respect your pricing, and we would be happy to reconnect in the future if we have a project with a more suitable budget.

Thank you again, and I hope we have the opportunity to work together another time.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 十、内部审批中

Hi [Name],

Thank you for your patience.

We have shared the collaboration details internally and are currently waiting for final approval.

I’ll get back to you as soon as the review is complete and we have a confirmed update.

Thank you again for your understanding.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 十一、财务付款处理中

Hi [Name],

Thank you for your patience.

The internal approval process has been completed, and the payment is currently being processed by our finance department.

I’ll share an update with you as soon as the payment has been completed.

Thank you again for your understanding.

Best,  
[Your name]

## 十二、项目暂停

Hi [Name],

Thank you again for your time and interest in collaborating with us.

Due to an internal adjustment to our current campaign plans, we need to pause this particular collaboration for the moment.

I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience, especially after the time you’ve already spent discussing the project with us.

We truly appreciate your understanding and would be happy to reconnect if a suitable opportunity becomes available in the future.

Best,  
[Your name]
